# HAPI v0.29.1.1 (maintained build)

Upstream-first rebuild from official `upstream/main` at `a729456682d4604dd65b75236c6a29a04ede9801` (official `v0.29.1` plus later main commits, including Claude local permission prompts from web) with 152 current open PRs audited: 29 carry, 119 defer, 4 drop.

## Compared with the previous maintained release

Compared with `v0.29.0.6`:

- Rebase onto current official main. Previously carried PRs that official already merged are inherited and not replayed (`#1776` `#1773` `#1770` `#1766` `#1761` `#1760` `#1757` `#1755` `#1754` `#1750` `#1748` `#1741` `#1707` `#1694` `#1685` `#1671` `#1633`).
- Keep `#1771` as the native `hapi-session-runtime` skill and deterministic JSON CLI commands.
- Keep small audited overlay carries, including project labels (`#1635`), hidden-agent picker (`#1451`), single-machine label omission (`#1414`), filter-time group collapse (`#1797`), PWA icons (`#1625`), unified sync labels (`#1617`), and single-line fork/rewind confirm copy (`#1603`).
- Retain the fork PID-reuse lock from `swear01/hapi#19`.
- Tighten personal exceptions this round: `#1468`, `#1662`, `#1436`, `#1607`, `#1610`, `#1542`, and `#1418` are deferred. `#1819` stays deferred this round even though latest-head HAPI Bot is now clean after the Auto-switch fix.

## Compared with the official release

Compared with official `v0.29.1`, includes the maintained desktop, fleet upgrades, imports, model-error handling, scratchlist, schema V29, protocol V2 overlay, session-roots guard, and the audited changes above.

Existing explicit drops remain in effect: `#1320` Antigravity is not replayed; `#1091` managed provider profiles stay dropped; `#1093`/`#1597` assistant response navigation stay dropped; `#1424` Jobs stay excluded because stale running jobs can pin inactive sessions.

## Personal PR policy exceptions

`#1771` is merge-dirty against the new official tip and spans a large integration surface; keep it as the native session-runtime skill (`PERSONAL_PR_POLICY_EXCEPTION`). `#1635`, `#1451`, and `#1421` are merge-dirty personal carries kept as focused overlay behavior. `#1419` is a ready personal carry. `#1468`, `#1662`, and `#1436` are not carried this round.

## Distribution

Standalone four-part maintenance release, with signed macOS CLI archives, Linux and Windows CLI archives, Windows/macOS desktop bundles, and `checksums.txt`. Optional platform packages remain on official `0.29.1`. The implicit standalone upgrade channel remains off; Windows uses the explicit verified hub-artifact rollout.
